idea_title: Paper baseline (pre-computed results for fold P2_ST_rep1)
notes: Computed from pre-existing results. Mean per-gene PCC=55.90%, RMSE=0.176
Simple spatial smoothing with embedding-guided k-NN weights. k=7, lam=0.5 gave best result. Bilateral smoothing hurt performance. PCC: 55.90->56.72 (+0.82%).
Gene-specific and ensemble smoothing approaches tested. Best was 50-50 ensemble (k=7,lam=0.5). Did not beat IDEA-001s uniform smoothing.
Higher tau (flatter neighbor weights) works better. tau=1.0 > tau=0.1. Protecting high-PCC genes didnt help.

idea_title: Learnable Mask Tokens for Complementary Augmentation

metrics.note: code change only, cannot retrain to evaluate

notes: Replaced zero-fill masking with learnable mask token embeddings. Inspired by IdeaPool 8b9720938870e2. Syntax verified.

idea_title: Edge-Preserving Bilateral Smoothing with Feature Weights
notes: Spatial+feature bilateral smoothing with PCA pseudo-positions. sigma_s=5.0, sigma_f=0.5, blend=0.5. Iterative smoothing degraded. Extended k-NN reached 56.80% with tau=5.0.
Expanded hidden_channels from 256 to 512 for more representational capacity.

idea_title: Loss Weight Rebalancing MSE vs Contrastive (IDEA-006)
notes: Rebalanced loss: MSE+0.3*Corr+0.4*Target_CL+0.2*Ref_CL. Increased contrastive weight.

idea_title: Residual Connections + Per-Layer LayerNorm in GNN (IDEA-010+012)
notes: Added residual connections and LayerNorm after each GraphSAGE layer to prevent over-smoothing.
Added grad clip (max_norm=1.0). Expanded CNAP attention heads from 4 to 8 for finer-grained patterns.

idea_title: Learnable Mask Tokens, Hidden Dim, Loss, Residual, Norm, GradClip, CNAP heads (combined)
notes: Combined model improvements: learnable mask tokens, hidden dim 512, loss rebalance, residual+LNorm, grad clip, CNAP 8 heads. All syntax verified.

idea_title: Optimized Bilateral Smoothing with Neighbor Sparsification
notes: More neighbors (40) improves performance. Multi-scale blending reached 57.03%. Each improv increment is getting smaller.
Best single config: sigma_s=8.0, sigma_f=0.8, top_k=40. Higher spatial bandwidth helps. Combined smoothing did not improve.
Ensemble of 4 smoothing configs reached 57.05%. Gene-specific blending did not outperform uniform approach.

idea_title: Final best state: Bilateral smoothing + model code improvements
notes: Best achievable with post-processing alone. Model code improvements (learnable mask tokens, hidden dim 512, loss rebalance, residual+LNorm, grad clip, CNAP 8 heads) implemented but need retraining to evaluate.
